\caption{Post hoc resampling constructions of $R$ (exploratory; descriptions, not limits). The first row was designated in amendment 16, after the intervals of constructions (a) to (d) and of the pigeonhole bootstrap had been seen and before it was computed; the others are sensitivity analyses. Interval: the 90\,\% Fieller interval from the covariance of the resampled change in Brier score $\Delta$ and baseline gain $D$, with a normal critical value. $\hat D/\mathrm{SE}$: the baseline gain over its resampling standard error. $\nu$: the effective number of clusters for $L_+=\Delta-\theta D$ at the upper end $\theta$ (Sect.~\ref{P-sec:posthoc} of the paper); $t_{0.95}$: the critical value on $\nu-1$ degrees of freedom. Upper ends with the normal ($z$) and the $t(\nu-1)$ critical value; a finite end exists only where the critical value is below about $\hat D/\mathrm{SE}$, and ``none'' marks no finite end or $\nu-1<1$. The coverage check of amendment 17 concerned the protocol's resampling (third row) in the protocol's simulations, which are less variable than the data; no construction has checked properties on data like these. Units: the resampled clusters (for (c) and (d), countries; for the pigeonhole bootstrap \citep{owen2007}, the smaller of the two factors). Split and reading: the primary split or the split that keeps activations whole, with the frozen reading of the protocol or the corrected reading of Norwegian names.}\label{tab:upper}
